[[File:Tephra detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Tephra''' are fragmental materials mined from rock formations within [[Zalcano]]'s prison beneath [[Prifddinas]], granting 35 [[Mining]] experience per tephra mined. [[Rock formation]]s that are glowing will yield tephra at a much faster rate. The [[Varrock armour]]'s double ore mining effect works here as well. Both the [[celestial ring]] and [[celestial signet]] (when charged) can give multiple tephra per mining action. As with all other suitable ore, a charge will be lost from the ring whether or not additional tephra is mined.

These are refined in the furnace to the east to create [[refined tephra]], then imbued at the altar to create [[imbued tephra]], which is used to deal damage to Zalcano's stone armour.

There is a 1/65 chance that 1-3 [[crystal shard]]s will be obtained while mining tephra.

Casting [[Superheat Item]] does not work. The [[Infernal pickaxe]] does not work on tephra.
